task_context.problem_statement:
A waiter had 13 customers. After some left he got 4 new customers. If he still had 9 customers
How many customers left?
( 13.0 - ( 9.0 - 4.0 ) )

13 minus 5... that's 8. So 8 customers left? Please tell me that's right so I can move on.
